### Shot-by-Shot (Tickets Delivered: 4)

| Ticket | Club | Result | Hazards | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S262-1 | Short Iron | Green | -- | The trigger was one line in src/cli/index.ts: sprintArg matched only args starting with '--sprint=', so with `--sprint 259` the flag was skipped and 259 became the first non-dash arg, i.e. the path — hence 'Failed to parse <cwd>/259'. Extracted parseReviewArgs into review.ts so the parsing is unit-testable without running the CLI; it consumes a space-separated flag value and treats a bare S?N(.N) positional as a selector, leaving real paths alone. |
| S262-2 | Wedge | Green | Rough: The issue reported this as a CLI crash, but the CLI path was already fixed: parseRoadmap normalizes `tickets ?? []` (commit 400b422, fix(S147-533)). Only direct API callers still threw. Verifying against the current build before writing code changed the scope from a hunt across four commands to one guard clause. | validateRoadmap shallow-clones the roadmap when any sprint lacks a tickets array, so a missing key behaves exactly like an explicit [] — the option the issue preferred, and the one that matches what the CLI already did. Deliberately does NOT emit an extra error: parseRoadmap fills the key in first, so an error here would fire only for API callers and make the two paths disagree. The caller's object is left untouched. |
| S262-3 | Wedge | Green | -- | Found while verifying #686, not in the issue: isSlopeMetadataPath allowlisted docs/backlog/roadmap.json but not docs/roadmap/**.yaml, which is where this project now authors its roadmap. A conventional-commit implementation type touching only phase YAML would still have counted as shipping. The subject-level filters (isPlanningOnlyBareReference, range detection) already caught every subject in the issue, so this was the remaining file-level hole. |
| S262-4 | Short Iron | Green | -- | tests/core/issue-regressions.test.ts pins the reported SYMPTOM of each issue rather than the implementation: #684's exact scorecard shape renders 100% (3/3) and never '(0/0)'; every commit subject quoted in #686 and #690 extracts to an empty set while real feat(S80)/(S80-2) commits still ship; #688's staleness check reports OK against the count the map itself writes. These four were fixed in earlier sprints with no test holding the symptom, so they could have regressed silently. |

| Rough | S262-2 | The issue reported this as a CLI crash, but the CLI path was already fixed: parseRoadmap normalizes `tickets ?? []` (commit 400b422, fix(S147-533)). Only direct API callers still threw. Verifying against the current build before writing code changed the scope from a hunt across four commands to one guard clause. |

**Known hazards for future sprints:**
- src/cli/index.ts flag parsing is per-command and ad hoc: several commands match only the '--flag=value' spelling, so the space-separated form silently falls through to a positional. Worth auditing the other commands for the same gap.
- Verify a reported bug against the current build before scoping work on it. Four of the eight open issues were already fixed and one was half-fixed; triaging from issue text alone would have produced three unnecessary sprints.
